policy: Editorial persistent baseline uses contract scale 0..2, not physical decibels. 0 is no persistent masking penalty, not a claim of silence. Moving river channels and exposed estuary families use 1 for ordinary persistent water masking. Backwaters and other families use 0. Weather, transient water events, human activity and animal calls are runtime events/modifiers and must not overwrite this baseline. No family is assigned persistent level 2 without stronger local evidence.
source_boundary: The family tuple and scene/G6 identities are copied from the exact expansion catalog; landscape/land-use/scene applicability retain the directness and confidence recorded in authoring-evidence.json. Numeric ambient values are explicit low-confidence analogical authoring judgments, never historical measurements.
